# AdapterEvent

`schemas/adapter/event.json`

Adapter → core notifications, normalised (docs/design/m0/09 "Notifications"), discriminated by event. Every one carries the attempt, its fencing token and the call. Outputs are fenced by the token; usage is not (05).

A document is one of: [CallSubEvent](#callsubevent) or [TurnStartEvent](#turnstartevent) or [TurnEndEvent](#turnendevent) or [DeltaTextEvent](#deltatextevent) or [DeltaThinkingEvent](#deltathinkingevent) or [DeltaToolCallEvent](#deltatoolcallevent) or [ToolRequestEvent](#toolrequestevent) or [ToolResultEvent](#toolresultevent) or [CoverageEvent](#coverageevent) or [UsageEvent](#usageevent) or [UpstreamEvent](#upstreamevent) or [CompactionEvent](#compactionevent) or [ErrorEvent](#errorevent) or [HeartbeatEvent](#heartbeatevent).

## Definitions

### AdapterTurn

1 for the first turn, the same domain as the ContextManifest records the turn feeds (manifest-delivery, manifest-finalized).

Type: integer (minimum `1`, maximum `1000000`)

### AdapterSubCall

The adapter's label for a model request within the call; not an authoritative id.

Type: string (pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$`)

### AdapterVersion

A semantic version (semver 2.0.0): major.minor.patch without leading zeros, optional prerelease and build metadata. The core compares the contract version's major (09 "Versioning").

Type: string (pattern `^(0|[1-9][0-9]*)[.](0|[1-9][0-9]*)[.](0|[1-9][0-9]*)(-(0|[1-9][0-9]*|[0-9]*[A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*)([.](0|[1-9][0-9]*|[0-9]*[A-Za-z-][0-9A-Za-z-]*))*)?([+][0-9A-Za-z-]+([.][0-9A-Za-z-]+)*)?$`, maxLength `128`)

### AdapterLabel

A short adapter-chosen label: a harness, a capability, a tool, a model id as the source serves it (the method schemas use it).

Type: string (pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._:/@+-]{0,127}$`)

### AdapterHandle

An attempt-scoped blob handle (M9), never a raw path. A handle naming another attempt than its event's is refused (internal/adapterhost).

#### Fields of AdapterHandle

| Field | Required | Type | Description |

| `attempt` | yes | [AttemptID](common-defs.md#attemptid) |  |

| `size` | yes | [Amount](records-resource-group.md#amount) |  |

No other fields are allowed.

Conditional rules (1, `if`/`then`/`else` in the schema):

- when `mediated_by_controller` `true`, then `delivered` any (not `null`); otherwise `delivered` `null`

The adapter's coverage declaration for a turn; it stays declared and never makes coverage complete by itself (M11).

| `unobservable` | yes | array of one of `harness_instructions`, `compaction`, `harness_tool`, `other` (unique items) |  |

No other fields are allowed.

Conditional rules (1, `if`/`then`/`else` in the schema):

- when `observable` `complete`, then `unobservable` `[]`

### UsageEvent

A usage delta the adapter observed for the call or a sub-call, numbered per call from 0 (05). It is a report, not a record: the controller mints the measurement id, takes the lease and attempt from the envelope it fenced, records kind delta, and sets source_of_truth itself, always adapter_report: the gateway records its own count of each request it sent as a measurement of its own (gateway_count, or gateway_floor when it read no usage), which an adapter final must not fall below to settle the call. Accepted even from a stale attempt: accounting is not fenced.

#### Fields of UsageEvent
